title: Reconcile primary-care-finder i18n: remove duplicate legacy key taxonomy
description:
## Summary

Collapse the duplicate i18n key taxonomy in **primary-care-finder**. The app catalog
(`apps/primary-care-finder/frontend/src/i18n/<locale>.ts`, 10 locales) currently carries the same
content under TWO key structures and they must be kept in sync. Consolidate to one.

## The two taxonomies

1. **NEW (the UI reads these):** `app.name`, `app.aboutTitle`, `app.aboutBody`, and the
   `filters.*` namespace. Used by `App.vue` (header title + `filterDefinitions`) and rendered by
   the phila-ui-4 `AppHeader` / `FilterChip` components (both are presentational — they take all
   strings as props; nothing to change in phila-ui-4).
2. **LEGACY (ported byte-exact from the original phila.gov primary-care app):** `app.title` /
   `app.subtitle`, plus top-level `ageRange.*`, `waitTime.*`, `specialty.*`, `tests.*`,
   `languages.category` — read by `LocationCard.vue` / `LocationDetail.vue`.

The category labels overlap, so the same string lives under two keys, e.g.
`filters.specialty` ⇄ `specialty.category`, `filters.waitTime` ⇄ `waitTime.category`,
`app.name` ⇄ `app.title`. There is already drift: in `en.ts`, `filters.specialty` = "Speciality
services" (misspelled) vs `specialty.category` = "Specialty services".

## Direction (per Andy)

Keep the NEW `filters.*` / `app.*` structure; remove the legacy duplicate keys. Repoint the detail
components (`LocationCard.vue`, `LocationDetail.vue`) to the consolidated keys.

## Must NOT remove

These legacy keys are detail-only and have NO `filters.*` equivalent — keep them:
`visitType.*`, `transit.*`, `exceptions.*`, `tooltips.*`, `patientType.*`, `cards.*`, `warnings.*`,
hours/day-name keys, `ageRange.child`/`adults` (singular/plural variants the chips don't use).

## Background / why this bead exists

Filed 2026-06-17 alongside the "option 1" back-fill: legacy translations were copied into the new
`filters.*` and `app.name` keys across all 9 non-English locales so the header title and the visible
filter-chip category labels translate immediately (root cause of the English-in-Spanish-mode bug was
that those NEW keys only existed in `en.ts`; the 9 ported locales lacked them and fell back to
English). That back-fill is interim and creates the very duplication this bead removes.

## Watch-outs

- Chip choices whose NEW English differs from the legacy wording were intentionally NOT back-filled
  and remain English-pending (see `MISSING.md`): `filters.mat` ("MAT" vs legacy
  "Medication-assisted treatment"), `nutrition`, `tobacco`, `pharmacy`, `blood`, `sti`, `covid`,
  `sameDay`. Reconcile decides whether to keep the short new chip labels or adopt legacy wording.
- Genuinely-new keys with no legacy source are still pending the city translation service:
  `filters.sort`/`distance`/`name`, language names, `app.aboutTitle`/`aboutBody`, `searchPlaceholder`,
  `closeDetails`, and the hours/schedule block.
- Pre-existing truncated legacy values to fix at source during this pass: `ht` `tests.category` =
  "Tès ak D"; `sw` `languages.category` = "Lugha inayozungumzwa na wafany" (should end
  "wafanyikazi"). They already ship in the detail panels and were copied verbatim into the new keys.

## Done when

- No label exists under two keys.
- `App.vue`, `LocationCard.vue`, `LocationDetail.vue` read a single consistent key set.
- All 10 locale files updated; app builds; no English fallback for previously-duplicated labels.
- `MISSING.md` updated to match the final key set.

title: Bump @phila/phila-ui-* vue-router peer ^4.0.0 -> ^5.0.0 so pinboard can drop the vue-router override
description:
## Background
primary-care-finder dev server came up blank / "Page Unresponsive" (branch `fix/vue-router-prod`, 2026-06-25). One contributing root cause: the monorepo loaded TWO vue-router versions.

## Why the duplicate exists
- Repo catalog pins `vue-router: ^5.0.6` (pnpm-workspace.yaml) → apps resolve 5.0.6.
- Published `@phila/phila-ui-core` and `@phila/phila-ui-link` declare a STALE peer `"vue-router": "^4.0.0"`. pnpm can't reconcile ^4 with the catalog's ^5, so it fragments into multiple `.pnpm` copies of those packages — some peered to vue-router 5.0.2, some 5.0.6. Result on disk: `packages/ui/node_modules/vue-router` = 5.0.2, app = 5.0.6.
- Prod build dedupes to one copy (works). Dev breaks because vite.config aliases `@pinboard/ui` to its SOURCE, so ui's `import 'vue-router'` resolves the 5.0.2 copy while the app uses 5.0.6 → two instances → router/route mismatch.
- `resolve.dedupe` can't fix it: dedupe merges duplicate copies of ONE version, not two different versions.

## Current workaround (in this branch)
Added `"vue-router": "5.0.6"` to root `package.json` > `pnpm.overrides`, forcing one version everywhere.

## The actual fix (this bead)
In phila-ui-4, bump the `vue-router` peerDependency from `^4.0.0` → `^5.0.0` in `@phila/phila-ui-core` and `@phila/phila-ui-link` (check the other `@phila/phila-ui-*` packages too), then republish the betas. Once consumed here, the pnpm override can be removed.

## Acceptance
- `@phila/phila-ui-core` and `@phila/phila-ui-link` published with `vue-router: ^5.0.0` peer.
- After bumping them in pinboard-3 and removing the `vue-router` override, `pnpm -C apps/primary-care-finder/frontend why vue-router` shows a single 5.0.x and the dev server renders (no afterEach loop).

title: Set up a deliberate testing strategy for the pinboard-3 monorepo
description:
## Why

pinboard-3 currently has **zero test infrastructure** — no vitest, no Playwright, no `*.spec.ts`/`*.test.ts`, and no `test` script anywhere in `apps/` or `packages/`. CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, job `check`) only runs lint + format:check + type-check + build. This is fine for two apps, but the monorepo is expected to host many finder apps over time, so the test strategy should be designed deliberately and once — not bolted on as a side effect of a feature.

This bead was split out of the translations work (`feat/primary-care-translations`) specifically so testing isn't decided "on a whim." Andy's call (2026-06-16).

## Scope to decide

- **Unit tests:** adopt vitest. Where does shared config live (root vs per-package)? How are pure-logic units tested across `packages/*` and `apps/*`?
- **E2E tests:** mirror what `phila-ui-4` does with Playwright, adapted for many apps (per-app specs, shared fixtures, base URL/config per app).
- **Turbo pipeline:** add a `test` task to `turbo.json`; decide caching/inputs.
- **CI:** add a test step (or steps) to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` `check` job; decide whether e2e runs on PR or only on `test`/`main`.
- **Conventions:** spec file location/naming, what's unit vs e2e, coverage expectations, how a new app inherits the setup.

## Already-prepared seams (low-hanging fruit once the framework exists)

The translations work intentionally built these as pure, isolated, easily-testable units — write their tests first when the framework lands:
- `mergeDeep` in `@pinboard/ui` — shared-vs-app message precedence (app wins).
- `useLocale` composable (primary-care) — locale resolution order (`?lang=` → localStorage → default `en`) and write-back.
- Locale key-parity — every locale has the same key set as `en`.

## Reference

- `phila-ui-4` already uses Playwright — study its config/structure as the starting point.
- Process: run through brainstorming → design → plan rather than ad-hoc.

title: Unify PinboardBody left overlays (consistent panel anchoring)
description:
Restructure PinboardBody's left-side overlays so the detail panel and filter
panel are anchored consistently. Deferred from the overlap-bug fix.

## Background
The filter panel and the location detail panel are both left-side `position: absolute`
overlays in `packages/ui/src/components/PinboardBody.vue`, anchored inconsistently:
- `.detail-overlay` (40% wide, z-index 10) is a ROOT-LEVEL SIBLING of `.finder-panel`,
  so its absolute box resolves against an ancestor above the finder (~40% of the whole
  app, anchored to the app top/bottom).
- `.all-filters-overlay` (33% wide, z-index 12) lives INSIDE `.finder-panel`
  (position: relative), so it's 33% of the finder panel.

The visible bug (open filters, then click a map point -> both overlays render, overlap,
and the app appears to resize) was fixed on branch `fix/filterpanel-detail-overlap` with
state-level mutual exclusion only: a watcher clears `allFiltersOpen` when a location is
selected (+ a defensive guard clearing the detail when filters open). That stops both
overlays rendering at once, but leaves the structural inconsistency in place.

## Work to do (pick one)
- Approach 3 (hybrid, smaller): move `.detail-overlay` INSIDE `.finder-panel` so both
  overlays share the same containing block and sizing rules. Keeps two overlays but makes
  them consistent.
- Approach 2 (full, cleaner): unify both into a single positioned left-panel slot inside
  `.finder-panel` driven by an `activePanel: 'filters' | 'detail' | null` state. Both
  contents render in the same container; mutual exclusion is by construction; the
  per-handler/watcher coordination from the band-aid fix can be removed.

After this, the mutual-exclusion watchers added in the band-aid fix may be simplified or
removed depending on the approach chosen.

## References
- Local design spec (gitignored): docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-26-filterpanel-detail-overlap-design.md
- File: packages/ui/src/components/PinboardBody.vue (`.detail-overlay`, `.all-filters-overlay`,
  `.finder-panel`, `selectedLocation`, `allFiltersOpen`).

title: Move @phila/phila-ui-* versions to pnpm.catalog
description:
# Move @phila/phila-ui-* versions to pnpm.catalog

## Why

Each package in the workspace currently pins `@phila/phila-ui-*` versions independently. Versions can drift between an app and `@pinboard/ui`, producing runtime errors like:

> `does not provide an export named 'CloseButton'`

Concrete instance (2026-05-27): `apps/primary-care-finder/frontend/package.json` was pinned to `@phila/phila-ui-button@2.2.3-beta.2`, but `packages/ui/package.json` was on `2.2.3-beta.3`. `SortPanel.vue` (in `@pinboard/ui`) imports `CloseButton`, which only exists in `beta.3`. Vite's `optimizeDeps` runs at the app root, sees the older pin, pre-bundles the older version, and serves a pre-bundle that doesn't have `CloseButton`. Bumped the app pin to `beta.3` as a one-off fix.

The skew is going to keep recurring as `@phila/phila-ui-*` packages are bumped — there's no single source of truth.

## What to do

Move every `@phila/phila-ui-*` version to `pnpm.catalog` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
catalog:
  '@phila/phila-ui-app-footer': 1.2.3-beta.3
  '@phila/phila-ui-app-header': 0.3.0-beta.9
  '@phila/phila-ui-bottom-sheet': 0.1.0-beta.7
  '@phila/phila-ui-button': 2.2.3-beta.3
  # ...etc
```

Then in each `package.json` that declares one, replace the version string with `"catalog:"`:

```json
"@phila/phila-ui-button": "catalog:"
```

Files to update:
- `packages/ui/package.json` — 12 phila-ui-* deps
- `apps/primary-care-finder/frontend/package.json` — 1 phila-ui-* dep
- `apps/oem-flood-finder/frontend/package.json` — 12 phila-ui-* deps

After: `pnpm install` to regenerate the lockfile.

## Verification

- `pnpm install` succeeds with no version conflicts in lockfile
- `pnpm dev:pc` and `pnpm dev:oem` both start without module-resolution errors
- `pnpm build` succeeds for all workspace packages
- Only one copy of each `@phila/phila-ui-*` package in `node_modules/.pnpm/` per version line (no duplicate hash variants)

## Out of scope

- Whether `@pinboard/ui` should re-export button components so apps don't need to depend on `@phila/phila-ui-button` directly. Decision deferred: keep direct deps in apps (clear intent), use catalog to prevent drift.
- Other (non-phila) shared deps like `vue`, `vue-router`, `@fortawesome/*` — could also move to catalog but not required to fix the drift problem.

## Requires

- pnpm 10+ (currently on 10.33.2 — fine)
